services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: At our museums, students experience hands-on/minds-on programs and tours that educate, enchant and engage. All programs feature inquiry-based learning, interactive content, and direct experience with original and/or reproduction artifacts. Choose a trip to the Mercer Museum, to Fonthill Castle, or combine both in a comprehensive and immersive experience. services.name: Mercer Museum Rentals
services.desc: Our beautiful clear-sided tent can seat up to 150 guests for plated dinner service, May through the end of October. Ceremonies take place outside in our ceremony garden complete with a tiny log house as your backdrop, or in the Elkins Gallery which features two fireplaces. Cocktail hour can be set up outside or in the Central Court of the castle. Dancing, after dinner, takes place in the Great Hall. Use of these spaces allows you and your guests to take full advantage of all the Mercer Museum has to offer and provides the ultimate, unique wedding experience.
